steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.octave: The biggest leap so far: the octave, from do up to the next do. It’s the same note, higher, which is why it sounds like it belongs. Breathe before it and keep the top note light; don’t reach up with your head. If the top do strains, sing it softly or skip it.
steps.arpeggio: Do, mi, sol, up to the high do, and back down: the leaps you know, one after another.
steps.twinkleIntro: Leaps are everywhere in songs. “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” starts with a fifth, from do up to sol, then comes back down by steps.
steps.twinkle: “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star”: listen, then sing it. Land right on sol after the leap.
steps.twinkleAlong: Now sing it along with the guide melody.
